interlude_1.speaker: dad
interlude_1.text: There. Page one, dry. A bit wrinkly. Thistledown's pop-ups stand up again, mostly.

interlude_1.speaker: nell
interlude_1.text: It's still ruined. The fox's tail is gone. Everything's taped.

interlude_1.speaker: gran
interlude_1.text: Taped isn't ruined, pet. Your grandad's mug has three glue lines and it's my favourite.

interlude_1.speaker: dad
interlude_1.text: No. It isn't. I'll do the next page tomorrow, all the same.
